info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: ' cala - kampane ' iti jvalAdO sTitasya (dfSyatAm 832) mittvArTe anuvAdaH . ' ...BftyAM cAlayet kampane calet ' (Slo. 158) iti devaH .

examples: GUrRitaH pracalAyita ityamaraH. yo nidrayA'BiBUta AsIna eva SiraScalayati kampayati sa pracalAyito Bavati.
'nyAyyAtpaTaH pravicalanti padaM na DIrAH' (Bartf॰1.84). nyAyamArgaM padamekamapi yAvannoccaranta ityAha. pravI samuditO viprakarzamAhatuH.
'nAdaRqyo nAma rAjYosti DarmAd vicalitaH svakAt' (yAjYa0 1.358). vicalito BrazwaH.
'aDikaraRavicAle ca' (pA0 5.1.43). vicAlo'nyaTAkaraRam, saNKyAntarApAdanam. ekasyAnekIkaraRam, anekasya cEkIkaraRam iti vfttiH.
'vicAlI hi saMvatsaraSabdaH, sAvanopi gaRitadivasakaH, SItozRavarzalakzaRo'pi cAndramasopi' (mI0 6.7.38 sUtre SA0 BA0). vicAlI=aniyataH.
'anuccalannapi raTAd BrUBaNagena cakAra saH. vilolA~llomakampena diNnAga iva BUDarAn' (rAja0 8.158).. anuccalan=anuttizWan. svasyADikaraRamavijahat ityarTaH.
